# Validating Topographical Measures in R

```{r}
library(igraph)
```

Load the graph data as a directed netowork.

```{r}
el <- read.csv("data/edges_20260413.csv", header = TRUE, colClasses = "character")
nl <- read.csv("data/nodes_20260413.csv", header = TRUE, colClasses = "character")
dg <- graph_from_data_frame(el, directed = TRUE, vertices = nl)
sdg <- simplify(dg, remove.multiple = TRUE, remove.loops = FALSE)
```

Take a look at the graph.

```{r}
`_layout` <- layout_with_kk(sdg)
plot(sdg, vertex.label = NA, vertex.size = 5, layout = `_layout`)
```

## Topographical Measures

```{r}
vcount(dg)
ecount(dg)
ecount(sdg)
degree(dg, mode = "total") |> mean()
# Degree centralization
centr_degree(sdg, mode = "out")$centralization
edge_density(sdg)
components(sdg, mode = "weak")$no
# Underected diameter
diameter(sdg, unconnected = TRUE, directed = TRUE)
transitivity(sdg, type = "average", isolates = "zero")
```
